policy: Episode readiness and throughput derive from native arena, combat and control journals plus timestamped IPC; driver pass flags do not establish readiness.

declared_outcomes.task_success: Terminated microtask with native distance, hit or blocked-attack proof.
declared_outcomes.death_or_down: Terminated duel with a native dead, unconscious or down actor.
declared_outcomes.time_limit: Truncated at the configured game-time budget, without a winner.
declared_outcomes.control_lost: Truncated scripted duel on a linked primary ownership release for target_visibility_lost; a failed candidate episode, without native continuation or a winner.
declared_outcomes.infrastructure: Crash, invalid setup or provider/transport watchdog; separate from combat and game-time outcomes.

throughput_gate.policy_transition: A unique eligible accepted non-continue command, an actual native segment start, and a linked command or episode outcome; locked observation ticks are not decisions.
throughput_gate.denominator: End-to-end scripted benchmark wall time including reset, IPC, local provider and final snapshot; excludes model inference, optimization and dataset writing.
throughput_gate.on_failure: Optimize the server runner before a large training collection; never move episode simulation to the Mac.

required_evidence: 100 consecutive dirty episode resets in one native runner process
Canonical native initial state repeats for a fixed seed/setup
Terminal or intentional pre-reset snapshot persists before world reset and recurrent token changes
Distance, applied melee hit and real blocked attack are computed by the native engine
Native duel terminal, game-time truncation and infrastructure failure are distinct
Paired native/scripted seeds and mirrored physical positions use identical initial setup
Eligible executed policy transitions, episodes/s and reset latency are measured separately
Archived native-off baseline seeds 17/29/43 still match
No graphics devices, model, renderer VRAM or production service changes
limitations: Scripted providers validate the environment; no GRU, model quality claim or training is part of stage 5.
Reset determinism covers canonical initial state; bit-identical whole-world evolution is not promised.
Collection time projections do not include optimizer, future GRU inference or stage 6 recorder overhead.
One CPU runner with CPUQuota 200 percent and at most two active combat actors is measured.
